hook: The elder nobleman confirms all entrances are covered, chillingly declaring that by sunset the 'witch' will be dead.
cliffhanger: Catherine sweeps down the aisle in a breathtaking bridal gown as the wedding reaches its triumphant peak, completely unaware of the looming doom.
reasoning: It packs a high-stakes conspiracy, a visual spectacle of a royal wedding, and an ominous threat into a tight, standalone punch.
